resources.title: Smart Plant Watering
resources.summary: Build a sensor that waters a plant when its soil is dry.
resources.bodyMarkdown:
## What you’ll build

A simple automatic watering system.

## Materials and tools

Gather an ESP32, a soil moisture sensor, and a small water pump.

## Build steps

1. Connect the sensor to the ESP32.
2. Connect and test the pump.
3. Upload the program and test with dry soil.

## Test your build

Confirm that the pump runs when the soil is dry and stops when it is moist.

See the [source code](https://github.com/example/plant-watering).

outcomes: Read soil moisture with a microcontroller
